subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which fix boundary should maintainers approve for Telegram slash elevated channel resolution: normalize bare session keys in `sandbox explain`, record slash-session metadata, or add a shared session-key channel parser used by runtime and diagnostics?
rationale: The bug affects elevated host-exec authorization and session/channel provenance, and there are multiple unmerged candidate fix shapes, so a maintainer should choose the durable security boundary before another repair competes with existing work.

options.title: Adopt one linked fix
options.body: Review and land the smallest linked candidate after adding maintainer-grade Telegram/elevated proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Supersede the existing candidates with a new narrow OpenClaw PR that implements the chosen session-key normalization boundary.

options.title: Fold into broader routing work
options.body: Keep this open as security/session-state debt until channel session metadata is refactored more broadly.

recommendation.title: Adopt one linked fix
recommendation.body: Review and land the smallest linked candidate after adding maintainer-grade Telegram/elevated proof and regression coverage.
